n: Idaho National Laboratory unplugged robot teddy bear activity
t: A floor grid activity where one student guides a robot to a lost teddy bear.
steps: Find the Teddy Is Lost activity on the Idaho National Laboratory site.
Tape a grid on the floor with painter's tape.
Place the teddy bear in one square.
Add other stuffed animals as distractions.
Choose a programmer and a robot.
Run the activity and try an extension.
